cover.themeSummary: 以合成内容展示视频与封面共同交付

timebase: captions and scenes use output seconds; photoTime uses original-source seconds
presenter: Optional project.presenter {fit: cover|contain, anchorY: 0..1}; optional scene.presenter large|compact. Defaults follow scene kind. Read presenter-motion.json in the delivery directory for generated position and size keyframes.
duration: source.end-source.start; frames round(duration*fps); only one continuous selected interval
runtime: getRuntime() returns ffmpeg/ffprobe/fontPath and ffmpegPath/ffprobePath aliases; run(executable,args,options) returns Promise of stdout/stderr
demo: generated synthetic test source/tone; not real speech or automatic ASR
